table.retrieve:
SELECT
		Saleinvcode=(select count(saleinvcode) from saleledger where SaleInvCode IN (SELECT Code1 FROM ReportData)), 
		SD.ICode, 
		Item = I.Name,
		packunits=max(I.packunits),
		itemalias=I.customicode,
		Packing=MAX(I.packingdesc),
		CustRefNo=MAX(SL.CustRefNo),
		PackQty = CAST(SUM((SD.looseQty + SD.BonusQty) / CASE WHEN SD.PackUnits > 0 THEN SD.PackUnits ELSE 1 END) AS INT),
		LooseQty = SUM(CAST((SD.looseQty + SD.BonusQty) AS INT)) % CASE WHEN MAX(SD.PackUnits) > 0 THEN MAX(SD.PackUnits) ELSE 1 END
FROM
		Saledetail SD,
		SaleLedger SL,
		Manufacturer M,
		ItemCategory ICT,
		ItemClass IC,
		Item	I
WHERE 
		SL.SaleInvCode IN (SELECT Code1 FROM ReportData) AND
		SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvcode AND
		SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
		I.ManfCode = M.ManfCode AND
		I.ICatCode = ICT.ICatCode AND
		I.ICCode = IC.ICCode
GROUP BY
		SD.ICode, 
		M.Name,
		ICT.Name,
		IC.Name,
		I.Name,
		I.customicode

ORDER BY
		I.Name
